method: Each claim checked against the retrieved abstract text of its cited source, not the citation.

claims.claim: Diagnosis: clinical interview covering sleep and medical history, questionnaires and diaries, exam where indicated (A)
claims.source_text: clinical interview (encompassing sleep and medical history); the use of sleep questionnaires and diaries (and physical examination and additional measures where indicated) (A)

claims.claim: Actigraphy not recommended routinely (C), may aid differential diagnosis (A)
claims.source_text: Actigraphy is not recommended for the routine evaluation of insomnia (C), but may be useful for differential-diagnostic purposes (A)

claims.claim: Polysomnography for other suspected sleep disorders and treatment-resistant insomnia (A)
claims.source_text: Polysomnography should be used to evaluate other sleep disorders if suspected (i.e. periodic limb movement disorder, sleep-related breathing disorders, etc.), treatment-resistant insomnia (A)

claims.claim: CBT-I first line for chronic insomnia in adults of any age including comorbidities, in person or digital (A)
claims.source_text: Cognitive-behavioural therapy for insomnia is recommended as the first-line treatment for chronic insomnia in adults of any age (including patients with comorbidities), either applied in-person or digitally (A)

claims.claim: Drugs offered when CBT-I not sufficiently effective (A)
claims.source_text: When cognitive-behavioural therapy for insomnia is not sufficiently effective, a pharmacological intervention can be offered (A)

claims.claim: Short-term (<=4 weeks): benzodiazepines (A), BZRAs (A), daridorexant (A), low-dose sedating antidepressants (B)
claims.source_text: Benzodiazepines (A), benzodiazepine receptor agonists (A), daridorexant (A) and low-dose sedating antidepressants (B) can be used for the short-term treatment of insomnia (<= 4 weeks)

claims.claim: Longer-term treatment may be initiated in some cases weighing advantages and disadvantages (B)
claims.source_text: Longer-term treatment with these substances may be initiated in some cases, considering advantages and disadvantages (B)

claims.claim: Orexin receptor antagonists usable up to 3 months or longer in some cases (A)
claims.source_text: Orexin receptor antagonists can be used for periods of up to 3 months or longer in some cases (A)

claims.claim: Medications more frequently used worldwide because of inadequate resources
claims.source_text: However, because of inadequate resources, medications are more frequently used worldwide

claims.claim: 170 randomised trials; certainty rated with CINeMA; acute and long-term
claims.source_text: We included 170 trials ... We assessed the certainty of evidence using the confidence in network meta-analysis (CINeMA) framework ... for the acute and long-term treatment of adults with insomnia disorder

claims.claim: PBS: temazepam, nitrazepam, amitriptyline unrestricted; zopiclone restricted; melatonin authority; daridorexant, suvorexant, lemborexant, zolpidem, doxepin not listed
claims.source_text: Schedule 4333 items query: Temazepam 20 rows ['A','R','U']; Nitrazepam 8 rows ['A','U']; Amitriptyline 17 rows ['U']; Zopiclone 8 rows ['R']; Melatonin 2 rows ['A']; Daridorexant no rows; Suvorexant no rows; Lemborexant no rows; Zolpidem no rows; Doxepin no rows
